scenes.text: This tutorial covers Annotator Agreement. Measure agreement between annotation columns and review the objects responsible for disagreement.
Open Annotator Agreement from the Results and quality control section. Choose a project database and two or more annotation columns covering the same objects.
In the main configuration area, select class handling, missing-label policy, grouping, sampling, and the agreement statistic.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. inspect Cohen or Fleiss kappa together with class-specific confusion and disagreement examples.
When the workflow finishes, agreement tables and a focused review set support label reconciliation and protocol improvement.
